statement: ONO-TR-772 is compound 14c: tert-butyl (4-chloro-3-((5-((4-fluorophenyl)ethynyl)-3-methylpyridin-2-yl)carbamoyl)phenyl)carbamate; structure checked on the SI scheme and NMR drawing, Table 3 and the follow-up Fig 1.
locator: SI pp. S28-S29; Table 3; follow-up Fig 1 [V6: the chemical name of 14c is on SI p. S24; S28 is the 13c NMR page and S29 the 14c NMR drawing (4-F-phenyl).]

statement: Four potency values for the same compound are in the source: Tl+ flux 0.26 uM, QPatch 0.15 uM (SI Table S2), human manual patch clamp 15 nM and mouse 67 nM (text). The ">67-fold" K2P selectivity equals 10 uM/0.15 uM, so the 15 nM headline (and the GtoPdb pIC50 7.82, labelled Rat) does not fit the paper own arithmetic; which is right cannot be decided from the SI. [V6 verified: 15 nM (abstract and Results, human manual patch clamp), 67 nM (mouse), 0.26 uM (Tl+ flux, Table 3, Fig 4), 0.15 uM (QPatch, SI Table S2 p. S4). 10 uM/0.15 uM = 66.7 matches '>67-fold'; 10/0.26 = 38. Not decidable from the SI: which is the true human patch-clamp value, the protocol, pH, temperature, species; whether 15 nM is a unit or decimal slip (INFERENZA). A reader may carry the Tl+ 0.26 uM (CHO human TREK-1, room temperature, HBSS + 20 mM HEPES, pH not stated; DATO) and QPatch 0.15 uM (method absent) and should quote 0.15-0.26 uM.]
locator: Abstract; Results para 4; Table 3; SI Table S2

statement: K2P panel: TREK-2 equipotent (QPatch 0.17 uM); TASK-3, TRESK, TWIK-2 above 10 uM (13-26 percent at 10 uM); at a single 10 uM manual patch clamp point TASK-1 17, TASK-2 7 percent inhibition and TRAAK -41 percent (activation). TASK-1 and TASK-3 are therefore not measured by concentration-response.

At 10 uM the ion-channel panel shows Kir2.2 51.6 (transient), KCNQ1/E1 47.3, hERG 38.4 percent, Cav1.2, HCN4, Kir2.1, Kv1.5, Kv4.3, Nav1.5 below 3 percent; binding off-targets A3, L-type Ca and Na channel site 2 have Ki 0.48-2.6 uM, 3 to 17 fold above the QPatch TREK-1 IC50 (arithmetic).
locator: SI Tables S1 and S3; main text Results para 4

statement: No pH series exists for ONO-TR-772: pH, temperature and activation protocol of its patch clamp are not in the main text or SI; Tl+ flux was in HBSS + 20 mM HEPES at room temperature with no stimulus. The follow-up paper SI gives the group whole-cell method (CHO-K1, bath pH 7.4, pipette 7.35, effect at 0 mV, no stimulus); applying it to this compound is INFERENZA. Absence perimeter: main text and SI text of two papers; PubMed name strings ONO-TR-772 and VU6018042 (2 and 1 hits, both the same two papers).
locator: SI Procedures; follow-up SI Patch clamp technique

statement: No neuronal data for ONO-TR-772: only mouse in vivo novel-object recognition (MED 10 mg/kg IP, male CD-1), total brain Cmax 888 nM, unbound estimate 5.3 nM against a mouse manual patch clamp IC50 of 67 nM; Irwin battery at 30 mg/kg shows near-zero scores. Absence perimeter: both papers plus PubMed strings on TREK-1 inhibitor with neurons/slice patch clamp (2 hits, neither on this compound).
locator: Results para 5; Fig 4; SI Fig S3

statement: Cpd8l is only reached at abstract level: IC50 0.81 uM, over 30-fold against other K, Na and TRP channels, neuroprotection in an OGD/R cortical neuron model that fell when TREK-1 was silenced; full text blocked (403), not retried.

KU124 inhibits TASK-1-GFP in inducible CHO cells in a Tl+ assay with IC50 1.38 +/- 0.65 uM from four concentrations without a plateau; no selectivity, no patch clamp, no pH, channel species not stated.

AVE1231 (A293) inhibits human TASK-1 in oocytes with IC50 0.2 +/- 0.1 uM (Hill 1.1, +40 mV, 20-22 C, pH 7.4 only); the paper measures no other channel; Kv1.5 origin is declared in the Introduction. [V6: the supplement IC50 0.2 +/- 0.1 uM (Hill 1.1, +40 mV) is not compatible with the main text at face value: at 245 nM the main text shows 26 percent block (about 56 expected) and at 10 uM 81 percent (about 98 expected); the two main-text points imply an IC50 near 1.2 uM (INFERENZA); the paper explains neither (+20 vs +40 mV, cumulative application and incomplete equilibration are possible).]

ONO-2920632 is a TREK-2 preferring activator (human Tl+ EC50 TREK-2 0.30, TREK-1 2.8 uM, 95 percent Emax; mouse patch clamp 0.57 and 2.7 uM) acting on unstimulated basal flux in heterologous cells; the pH of the activation assays is not stated and no acid-pHo or stimulated-current test exists in the paper. [V6: 'acting on unstimulated basal flux' is the producer's reading of the SI protocol (INFERENZA), not a statement of the paper; the abstract says >91-fold selectivity while the Results say >150-fold.]

No source reached reports a stated Hill slope for TREK-1 pHo dependence: the one numeric pH50 is 7.51 (oocytes, 22.5 C, slope unstated, carried); Sandoz 2009 gives pK near 7.4 and "steep" in the abstract only; Cohen 2008 and the Sandoz full text were behind bot checks; no 30-37 C source found. Perimeter: PubMed strings and author-led searches on 2026-11-11 (queries.tsv), two routes (name-led and target-led).

Catalogue rows carry labels the primaries do not support: ONO-TR-772 15 nM labelled Rat (paper: human; QPatch 0.15 uM), KU124 labelled Human (paper does not state the channel species), Cpd8l labelled Rat (abstract unspecific); the pEC50 5.55 of ONO-2920632 matches the human Tl+ TREK-1 EC50 2.8 uM.
